props.title: We hire engineers who argue with the spec.
props.lede: If you have ever refused to ship something you could not defend in review, you will recognise how we work.

props.heading: No open roles listed right now.

content.text: We keep this page honest rather than perpetually advertising positions that do not exist. If you are strong and the timing is wrong, write anyway — we would rather know you early.

props.heading: Four things we check for in every hire.

cards.title: Reads the codebase before proposing a rewrite.
Writes the test that would have caught it.
Can explain a trade-off to someone non-technical.
Says “I do not know” early rather than late.
